about: The bridge between the sealed reader frame and its parent, protocol 1, as fixtures for any parser of it: the frame reads parent-to-frame messages, the parent reads frame-to-parent messages and applies its limits.

messages: one message each, with its direction, for a parent-to-frame message its channel (hello arrives on the window, every other parent op on the port), the number of transferred ports (0 when absent), and the verdict of the reader on the receiving side: accept, or refuse with a reason from the closed list in reasons.

A frame-to-parent case is judged by a parent that already holds a valid ready, except a ready case, which is judged as the first message. A parent-to-frame changes.result case is judged while context.inFlightSha is the one changes request in flight.

fill: before judging, each named key of the message is set to prefix + unit repeated times + suffix (prefix and suffix default to empty). Caps on values are counted in UTF-8 bytes; caps on href, hash and the mermaid text in UTF-16 code units.

given: an optional state the parent holds besides a valid ready, for the verdicts that depend on it: places (true when its seed asked for bridge.places; absent is false) and run, the open print run, with n (the figure count its first accepted figure set, or null before it), seen (the indexes accepted) and bytes (what they decode to, together). Absent run: none is open. A case with no given is a parent that asked for neither places nor print figures.
Every refused case has exactly one fault, except a case with a proto key, which is also outside every op key set: proto-key is checked before the key set.

sequences: frame-to-parent messages after a valid ready at time 0, each step at a time in whole milliseconds since ready, count times (1 when absent), with the verdict of the parent limits read as token buckets (sequenceRules). closes marks the refusal that closes the bridge.

sequenceRules: Two token buckets, both full at ready: a general bucket of bucketCapacity (40) tokens refilled at bucketRefillPerSecond (20) a second, and a store.set bucket of storeSetBucketCapacity (10) refilled at storeSetRefillPerSecond (10) a second.

Refill is continuous, counted in whole milliseconds and kept in integer milli-tokens: each elapsed millisecond adds the refill rate in milli-tokens (20 for the general bucket, 10 for the store.set bucket), up to the capacity; a token is 1000 milli-tokens.
Every message takes one general token; a store.set also takes one store.set token. A message is accepted only when every bucket it draws on holds a whole token. A refused message takes no token.
Every refusal counts toward refusalsToClose (16) for the life of the mount; the refusal that reaches it closes the bridge.
